+.name: Association
+.description: Combine or link two ideas so they coexist and support each other
examples: A + B: A associates with B
spiritual mind + positive energy: harmonious reinforcement

-.name: Disassociation
-.description: Sever or remove the influence of the second idea from the first
examples: A - B: A removes influence of B

*.name: Intensification
*.description: Amplify the interaction so the effect is stronger or fused
examples: A * B: A intensifies through B

/.name: Opposition
/.description: Create contrast or tension between two ideas
examples: A / B: A contrasts with B
